s01.h1: Let Buyers See the Exact View Before They Reserve
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: From one master 3D model, Manzili builds an Unreal Engine 5 app that runs offline on your showroom hardware and a lightweight web platform buyers open on any phone.

s02.h2: One Master Model, Two Ways to Sell
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: Most developers juggle visual files from several agencies. Manzili builds one master 3D model from your BIM and CAD files, then produces two versions of it to cover the whole buyer journey.
s02.block01Subtitle: Runs Offline in Your Sales Gallery
s02.block01Body: Built for sales gallery touch tables, LED walls and VIP suites. The app runs fully offline, so a dropped connection can't interrupt a presentation. Unreal Engine 5 renders native 4K at 60 FPS with full architectural detail and accurate sun angles.
block01Features: Runs fully offline on local workstations
Tuned for touch tables and LED walls
s02.block02Body: Compressed automatically from the same master model, the web platform loads 3D masterplans in standard phone and desktop browsers. Buyers explore and select units over 4G or 5G, with nothing to download.
block02Features: Opens in Safari, Chrome and Edge
Loads in under 3 seconds on mobile networks

s03.h2: How One Model Protects Your Launch
s03.card01Title: Presentations That Don't Depend on Wi-Fi
s03.card01Body: The Unreal Engine 5 app runs on local showroom hardware, so a Wi-Fi dropout or slow network doesn't stall a VIP meeting.
s03.card02Title: Every Screen Shows the Same Plans
s03.card02Body: Both versions come from one master model, so unit types, prices and design updates match across showroom displays and the web platform.
s03.card03Body: Capture high-intent buyers remotely on the web platform, then bring them into the showroom app to choose their unit and reserve.

s04.h2: From BIM Files to Two Sales Tools
step01: We ingest your Revit, CAD and IFC files and build one high-precision master model with accurate structure and coordinates.
step02: The master model compiles into an Unreal Engine 5 app configured for your showroom touch tables, LED walls and presentation machines.
step03: An automated pipeline compresses the geometry for fast browser streaming, ready to publish when you are.

s05.q1: Why deploy both an offline UE5 app and a web platform?
s05.a1: Showroom presentations need full graphics power and no dependence on the internet, which the offline Unreal Engine 5 app delivers. Remote buyers need instant access with nothing to install, which the web platform delivers.
s05.q2: What happens to the offline UE5 app if showroom Wi-Fi disconnects?
s05.a2: The buyer won't notice anything. The app runs entirely on local hardware, so presentations, touch controls and 4K navigation carry on. Inventory updates queue locally and sync as soon as the connection returns.
s05.q3: What happens when architectural designs or phase layouts change?
s05.a3: Changes go into the single master model and publish to the showroom app and web platform together, so both always show the same plans.
